# TurboApply Agency

TurboApply is a Vancouver-based IT company building websites, AI integrations, CRM automations, AI receptionist flows, cold outreach systems, lead follow-up systems, and booking/funnel improvements for small and growing businesses.

Canonical site: https://turboapply.agency/
Contact email: turboapply.ai@gmail.com
Phone: +1 (778) 819-3665
Booking: https://turboapply.agency/book-meeting/
MCP endpoint: https://turboapply.agency/mcp
Structured AI context: https://turboapply.agency/ai/turboapply-agency-context.json

Key pages:
- / — main website and portfolio/services overview.
- /services/ — current 13-offer directory for audits, websites, SEO, AI/CRM automation, lead generation, marketing, and support. Business Process & Automation Audit and Web Design have dedicated pages; all other offers remain available by request from the directory.
- /book-audit/ — dedicated free audit-consultation form; accepted requests continue to the existing Calendly booking route.
- /services/web-design/ — the current dedicated Web Design page with the shared TurboApply editorial design system, approved hero and portfolio media, process, pricing, FAQs, related services, no placeholder reviews, and a secure inquiry form.
- /integrations/ — CRM, booking, lead capture, payments, reporting, communication, and AI workflow integrations.
- /agents/ — practical AI agents for scheduling, lead generation, follow-up, data enrichment, cold outreach, and sales coaching.
- /about/ — Katerina and Vasiliy, the story behind TurboApply, the four-step agency process, approved Ozero Grez, TruthHoly, and SignoGroup client reviews, practical social videos, and a secure contact form.
- /resources/ — TurboApply Academy guides for website SEO, local visibility, service pages, technical audits, lead workflows, automation, AI receptionists, testing, and operational handoff.
- /resources/website-launch-checklist/ — service-business website launch checklist.
- /resources/map-a-lead-workflow/ — lead-workflow mapping playbook.
- /resources/ai-receptionist-launch-checklist/ — AI receptionist launch and review guide.
- /resources/local-seo-checklist-service-businesses/ — local SEO checklist for service businesses.
- /resources/seo-friendly-service-page/ — guide to planning an SEO-friendly service page.
- /resources/technical-seo-audit-checklist/ — technical SEO audit checklist for small-business websites.
- /resources/google-business-profile-guide/ — Google Business Profile optimization guide for service businesses.
- /resources/interactive-website-effects/ — guide to interactive website animations, their pros and cons, and when they are worth implementing, with the live TurboApply Version 3 demo.
- /resources/fluid-holographic-shape-animation/ - Fluid holographic shapes guide with a black luxury TurboApply Agency real-time holographic loop, small circular cursor indicator, pause control, and reduced-motion fallback.
- /resources/reflection-cover-animation/ - Reflection cover animation guide with the supplied image, a Noomo storytelling reference, and a pointer-reactive water-flowing disturbance.
- /resources/product-parallax-scroll-effects-food-drink/ - product parallax scroll effects collection for food and drinks websites, with 19 reference sites, the requested two-line brand/style paragraph formula, a short intro, and Keywords section.
- /resources/technology-website-animation-examples/ - technology website animation examples starting with Anime.js as the implementation reference, then product, watch, aviation, hardware, and device examples.
- /resources/product-website-design-examples/ - product website design examples for physical products, AI, health, beauty, hardware, ecommerce, and XR.
- /resources/storytelling-sites-scroll-design-examples/ - storytelling website collection with immersive scroll, scrollytelling, cinematic landing page, and narrative UX examples.
- /resources/health-biotech-website-aesthetics-examples/ - health, biotech, longevity, wellness, and AI website aesthetics collection with scientific minimalism, organic gradients, and health-tech UX examples.
- /resources/cosmetics-website-design-examples/ - growing cosmetics and skincare website collection for premium product photography, beauty ecommerce UX, and ingredient-led brand storytelling.
- /resources/best-website-reference-sites/ - best website reference sites covering CSS Design Awards, Mobbin, Awwwards, and Behance.
- /resources/turboapply-vs-no-code-website-builders/ - comparison of no-code website platforms and a custom TurboApply build.
- /results/ - source-backed World Top Martial Arts, Peniby’s Wellness, and Ozero Grez work records.
